raisedBecause: FOUR STRINGS OF NEW DEBT, WRITTEN DELIBERATELY, ALL MINE. The lens did not move and nothing became newly visible: same checker, same roots, same rules as the 308 run. Four sentences were added to components/shell while fixing the redirect loop and the status pill, and each exists because the alternative was a screen that lies. Listed individually below so a reader can judge them one at a time rather than accept a number. I do not own this file - `rtl-arabic-pdpl-specialist` does - so this raise is filed to their inbox with the same arithmetic; lower it by cataloguing the four, which I did not do because no other string in this module is catalogued and wiring `useI18n` into two shell components is M8's job, not a fix round's.

theFourStrings: ConnectionStatus.tsx - 'The runner has no usable Anthropic API key, so no agent can be started from here...'. The whole point of the fix: `runnerConfigured: false` used to render as `UNKNOWN . 0 QUEUED`, which is indistinguishable from a healthy idle runner. The sentence is the reason, and it carries the env var name because that is the thing that turns it off.

LegacyRouteResolver.tsx - title 'Nothing at this address'. The screen shown when a URL names a project and the path under it resolves to nothing. It replaces an unbounded redirect loop, so there was no previous copy to reuse.
LegacyRouteResolver.tsx - 'This link names the project'. First half of that screen's body, split from the third entry by a `{named}`.

LegacyRouteResolver.tsx - '. Nothing has been redirected, because there is nowhere to redirect to...'. Second half of the same sentence. It counts as two findings because the project slug is interpolated as an element; joining them into one template would lower this number by one and make the sentence untranslatable, which is the trade the catalogue rule exists to refuse. Not done.
raiseArithmetic.howTheSplitWasMeasured: `node scripts/check-rtl.mjs --gate` against this working tree reported exactly three movements - total 308->312, hardcoded-string 283->287, components/shell 91->95 - and no other module moved. `drawer-engineer` had ~20 files uncommitted under apps/web at the same moment and contributed zero, because they catalogued theirs. Every one of the four was then located by name in `check-rtl.mjs` output and matched to a line I wrote today; the arithmetic is 4 findings identified individually, not a delta accepted because it was small.
raiseArithmetic.whatWasDeliberatelyNotUpdated: `notCounted` is left at its 2026-08-17 figures although four of its blind-spot counts have moved (expression-attribute 85->101, assembled-template 89->91, panels-json 149->153, multiline-plain-template 1->2). Those are never compared by the ratchet, and most of the movement belongs to concurrent work in `drawer/` and `panels/` that is not mine to attribute. Rewriting them under my name would put another agent's numbers behind my signature, which is the exact defect this file's own header warns about. They should be re-measured on a still tree by their owner.

hardFails: missing-catalogue · missing-translation · missing-plural-class · orphan-translation do NOT go through the ratchet, and must never appear in byRule or byModule below. The ratchet asks 'did this number go up', which is the wrong question for a property whose only acceptable value is zero: the moment a baseline RECORDS one of these, the gate accepts it forever and accepts a different one in its place. Falsified, not reasoned — with missing-translation:1 recorded here, deleting 'shell.tab.chart' from strings.ar.ts gave regressions [], the word 'holding', and (before the hard-fail set existed) exit 0, with an English key untranslated.
